Nonnegative integrable kernels justify the long-time limits and yield ratio a²/(a²+3ab+b²). Source dimer parameter matching also equates its published mean entropy-production formulas. The accompanying independent 95-/50-state Markov moment evolution, tested against analytic quadrature across 3 parameter sets and 4 horizons, passed 84 deterministic checks; finite checks supplement, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: Two experimentally motivated nonreciprocal Brownian-dimer protocols can be calibrated to share the entire center-of-mass MSD curve and the same entropy-production mean, making those central diagnostics unable to distinguish them. The strictly ordered fourth cumulants for every positive time supply a complete discrimination criterion, while the dimensionless asymptotic ratio gives an amplitude-, thermal-, and readout-noise-independent signature. This is a physically motivated structural distinction in observable stochastic transport, not arbitrary parameter slicing; nonlinear correlations, repulsion and statistical power remain outside scope.
